archive: v0.8 development failures and reruns, before final stage B freeze
scope: Historical counterexamples, initial experiment mistakes, production integration defects and pre-freeze reruns are distinguished; none of these dirty runs substitutes for a frozen formal result.

entries.root_cause: Complete archived db7949b execution reproduced nested JSON bool/number conflict failures. The first driver additionally compared dependency references with artifact_id versus object_id as literal dictionaries, causing 17 spurious binding-check failures despite correct production dependencies.
entries.resolution: Only the driver measurement was corrected to compare exact object/version identity; the original report and reconstructed byte-identical original driver are preserved. Corrected historical rerun is separate.

entries.root_cause: Nested true/1 and false/0 conflict detection failed and acceptance depended on order. Arrays containing true/1 could both pass. Corrected dependency assertion passed all 17 branches. 14 failed assertions include 10 explicit-truth failures and 4 order-diagnostic failures; this is not a production success score.
entries.resolution: Production equality became recursively JSON-type-aware and conflicting whole fields have no selected winner; formal repair evidence is in stage A P0. Detailed original evaluation archive remains v08-json-before.json.

entries.root_cause: The frozen old runtime could not establish the same project alias for the replacement work because adoption was keyed by project alias rather than work edition.
entries.resolution: Work-edition bindings now separate workspace alias, exact binding, policy target and submission snapshot; stage A P1 is the formal result.

entries.root_cause: 24/27 checks passed, all executed. Two whole-submission comparisons incorrectly treated current_applicability (current to superseded_requirements) as immutable. A third expected condition status satisfied, whereas the common runtime status is resolved.
entries.resolution: Require exactly the declared applicability projection change while preserving every other original payload/review/adoption field; use resolved as the condition outcome. No production semantics were changed for these three failures.

entries.root_cause: The three initial measurement expectations were corrected.
entries.resolution: 27/27 passed; do not add this repeated development denominator to the frozen stage A result.

entries.root_cause: The private-input fixture mistakenly declared a non-reader as a writer; revision fixture used power revise instead of the actual revise_requirement. Runtime correctly rejected these malformed/unauthorized setups. 33/55 checks passed, 22 were unexecuted.
entries.resolution: Corrected the package declarations; preserved all original reports. Neither failure established a production worker or authorization defect.

entries.root_cause: 54/55 checks passed with no unexecuted checks. All worker scenarios reached intended outcomes, but the old-submission whole-dictionary comparison included the legitimate current_applicability projection update.
entries.resolution: Require the exact superseded_requirements projection change, preserve all remaining original submission facts, and compare unrelated works in full.

entries.root_cause: Measurement corrected and literal submitted JSON values were independently checked (11, 7, replacement 19, multisource 15).
entries.resolution: 55/55 checks passed. This run does not cover the later automatically published successor supplement.

entries.root_cause: Added published_successor as a separate 12-check closed loop: original public B delivery11, A write/publish only, automatic successor, explicit policy checkpoint resume and new public B delivery19.
entries.resolution: 67/67 development checks passed (original55 plus12). Subsequent pre-freeze tightening also checks unchanged B artifact registry at release and unrelated A work; its targeted test passed, but this earlier raw dev4 report is not relabeled as that later source execution.

entries.root_cause: Provider availability changed before the old unavailable acknowledgement arrived. A new request resolved, but the still-pending old condition later became unavailable and kept the same current work blocked.
entries.resolution: New available-route requests supersede older open as well as unavailable conditions from earlier availability revisions, preserving request/reply history. Fix verification belongs to the current targeted tests and later frozen stage B result, not this before report.
entries.interpretation_original: New availability before the old unavailable reply; both are genuine versioned requests. Old stale condition must not keep the same current work blocked.

entries.root_cause: The 180 checks passed but the historical-observation preservation check compared an empty state.observations prefix. WorldCore.observe is read-only, so that prefix did not establish retention of actual public observations.
entries.resolution: Keep the raw 180-check draft unchanged; capture original observe returns directly before event execution in actual-observations-v2.

entries.root_cause: The repeated draft also passed 180 checks while retaining the same empty-observation-prefix evidence gap.
entries.resolution: Do not count it as independent observation coverage; draft3 changes capture and requires nonempty current-work context.

entries.resolution: Record three actual pre-cut role observations inside the checkpoint, retain file bytes/hashes through controls and recovery, and compare actual new observations separately.

entries.root_cause: actual-observations-v2 persists the actual pre-event public observation and exact stage action returns in files; it requires nonempty work context and preserves their bytes/hashes across the event.
entries.resolution: 20/20 cases and 180/180 checks passed on dirty pre-freeze source. This fixes the measurement gap, not a new production kernel defect; frozen formal results remain separate.
entries.observation_evidence_policy_original: observe() is read-only and does not append state.observations. Capture its actual pre-event return and exact stage tool returns in files immediately, require nonempty current-work context, then compare the retained file bytes and hashes after the event. Earlier draft/draft2 empty-state-prefix checks do not provide this coverage.

entries.root_cause: actual-observations-v2 stores three actual pre-cut role observations inside the checkpoint and verifies nonempty work/version facts and retained bytes in both control and recovered worlds.
entries.resolution: Two cuts and 20/20 checks passed on dirty pre-freeze source. No arbitrary crash or broader historical reconstruction claim is added.
entries.observation_evidence_policy_original: WorldCore.observe is read-only: state.observations may be empty and is not used as evidence of historical observation coverage. Immediately capture three actual pre-cut role observations as control/recovery-prior-observations.json inside the checkpoint, copy them byte-for-byte, and require their nonempty work/version facts and unchanged hashes after control/recovery. New actual post-cut observations are compared separately.
